a.description: array_like The shape and data-type of `a` define these same attributes of the returned array.

order.description: {'C', 'F', 'A', or 'K'}, optional Overrides the memory layout of the result. 'C' means C-order, 'F' means F-order, 'A' means 'F' if `a` is Fortran contiguous, 'C' otherwise. 'K' means match the layout of `a` as closely as possible.

subok.description: bool, optional. If True, then the newly created array will use the sub-class type of `a`, otherwise it will be a base-class array. Defaults to True.

shape.description: int or sequence of ints, optional. Overrides the shape of the result. If order='K' and the number of dimensions is unchanged, will try to keep order, otherwise, order='C' is implied.
constraints: shape must be int or sequence of ints, optional

device.description: str, optional The device on which to place the created array. Default: None. For Array-API interoperability only, so must be ``"cpu"`` if passed.
constraints: device must be str, optional and Default: None. For Array-API interoperability only, so must be ``"cpu"`" if passed.

output.description: ------- MaskedArray Array of ones with the same shape and type as `a`.
